elements.description: Top-level visual content in render order. Use a structural element to group related children and primitive elements for individual values.
elements.title: Ordered list of visual elements, structures, and content

UiContainer.description: Provides the shared root content collection inherited by cards and other root models. The order of elements is significant and is preserved by the renderer.
UiContainer.title: Root container holding an ordered list of visual elements.

title.description: Primary heading for the card. Keep it concise enough for the card header; longer explanatory text belongs in description or elements.
title.title: Human-readable feature title displayed in the card header

description.description: Brief secondary context shown with the title. Use the content elements for detailed information rather than placing an entire report in this field.
description.title: Optional neutral subtitle / description for the feature

actions.description: Optional user-invokable actions shown after the card content. Their order is preserved and each action's own fields define its command or link behavior.
actions.title: Optional card action buttons rendered at the base of the feature card

UiCard.description: A complete card has a required title and ordered content inherited from UiContainer. It is designed for the feature-card surface; description and actions supplement the content, with action controls rendered separately from the element list.
UiCard.title: Root container for a complete feature card.

type.description: Concrete element tag. Derived models narrow this string to a literal such as string, table, or image-ref; it is used for polymorphic decoding and renderer selection.
type.title: Discriminator property identifying the concrete visual component

UiElement.description: Every concrete visual element carries a type discriminator whose literal value selects its model and renderer. The @discriminator("type") metadata lets schema emitters and SDK generators represent derived models as a polymorphic hierarchy. Consumers should dispatch on the discriminator and preserve unknown elements when round-tripping data where possible.
UiElement.title: Polymorphic root model for visual UI elements.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the ViewKit envelope contract. It is a literal value and should be preserved when serializing or forwarding a document.
schemaVersion.title: Schema specification version

Envelop.description: All root ViewKit documents extend this envelope so consumers can identify the schema contract version before processing the root content.
Envelop.title: Base envelope containing the schema version.

value.description: Text to render. Supply plain text; this field is not a Markdown or HTML document.
value.title: Text value

representation.description: Selects inline, chip, or multiline rendering. The default is plain, so callers can omit this for ordinary text.
representation.title: Display representation mode

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

StringElement.description: Use this primitive for one textual value when a structured label/value row is unnecessary. Choose multiline for content whose line breaks should remain visible; modifiers apply presentation traits without changing the underlying value.
StringElement.title: Text value primitive with selectable inline, chip, or multiline presentation.

values.description: Values to render in order. Each array entry remains a distinct item for chip presentation and is not parsed as a delimited string.
values.title: Array of string values

representation.description: Selects whether values appear as ordinary inline text or as separate visual chips. The default uses the plain representation.
representation.title: Display representation mode (plain text or visual chips)

separator.description: Separator inserted between adjacent values in plain representation. It does not become part of any value.
separator.title: Optional visual separator rendered between sequential values

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

StringsElement.description: Use this primitive when several related strings should be rendered as one compact sequence. The client preserves the array order and inserts the selected separator between values.
StringsElement.title: Collection of textual values rendered as an inline sequence or chips.

value.description: Code or text snippet to display. Include any desired line breaks in this string.
value.title: Text value

language.description: Optional syntax hint for the renderer. Supported values describe highlighting modes and do not validate the snippet's syntax.
language.title: Optional syntax highlighting language identifier

StringCodeElement.description: Use for source-like or preformatted textual content that should be rendered in a code-oriented style. The language is a presentation hint; the content is not parsed or validated as code by this contract.
StringCodeElement.title: Monospace code block or formatted code snippet representation.

value.description: XML markup to render. The contract carries the source text; it does not guarantee that the document is well-formed.
value.title: XML content value

XmlElement.description: Specialized code-oriented element for XML content. It uses the custom XML renderer rather than requiring consumers to construct a generic code block.
XmlElement.title: XML markup code block element.

value.description: Serialized JSON text to render. No parsing or schema validation is implied by this element.
value.title: JSON content value

JsonElement.description: Specialized representation for JSON text. Supply serialized JSON when consumers should display a JSON document; this field is a string and is not structurally validated here.
JsonElement.title: JSON data or structure representation element.

value.description: Destination associated with the link. Supply a URL or client-recognized navigation target supported by the renderer.
value.title: Target URL or navigation destination

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

StringUrlElement.description: Use this element when displayed text should also behave as a link. Unlike StringElement, the value is a navigation destination and may be paired with a separate human-readable label.
StringUrlElement.title: Hyperlink representation for external or internal URL navigation.

value.description: Identifier text to display, such as an opaque ID or hash. Avoid embedding presentation markup in the value.
value.title: Identifier string value

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

IdentifierElement.description: Use for identifiers, hashes, and other machine-oriented strings that benefit from monospace styling. The value remains text and is not resolved as a Picteus entity.
IdentifierElement.title: Monospace semantic identifier representation.

value.description: Numeric ratio value used by the renderer to produce an aspect-ratio display.
value.title: Aspect ratio numerical expression

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

RatioElement.description: Displays a numeric aspect ratio as a ratio expression. Provide a positive value meaningful to the surrounding content; this type does not encode the source image dimensions.
RatioElement.title: Aspect ratio representation (e.g. "16:9", "4:3", "1:1").

width.description: Horizontal pixel count. Values below one are rejected by the schema constraint.
width.title: Width in pixels

height.description: Vertical pixel count. Values below one are rejected by the schema constraint.
height.title: Height in pixels

DimensionsElement.description: Displays a width/height pair as image dimensions. Both values are positive pixel counts; together they describe dimensions, not an aspect ratio or a resize request.
DimensionsElement.title: Image dimensions representation displaying formatted width and height in pixels.

value.description: Color value used to draw the swatch. Use a hexadecimal representation supported by the client renderer.
value.title: Hexadecimal color code

label.description: Human-readable color name available to the renderer when text is shown.
label.title: Optional descriptive color name label

showText.description: When true, allows the renderer to show the color's text label alongside the swatch. The default is true.
showText.title: Whether to display the textual color code or label next to the swatch

shape.description: Geometry used for the swatch; defaults to a circle.
shape.title: Visual shape of the color indicator

size.description: Relative size class for the swatch; defaults to medium.
size.title: Visual size of the color indicator

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

ColourElement.description: Displays one color swatch with configurable geometry and optional adjacent text. Supply the color as a hexadecimal string; the schema leaves exact accepted hex formats to the renderer.
ColourElement.title: Single color representation with hex value, shape/size styling, text display toggle, and copy affordance.

value.description: Number to display. Its meaning and any valid range are defined by the producing feature.
value.title: Numeric value

unit.description: Short unit label appended or otherwise associated with the displayed value. Include only the unit text, not a second copy of the number.
unit.title: Optional unit suffix (e.g. "px", "ms", "MB")

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

NumberUnboundedElement.description: Displays a numeric value without a progress scale or rating interpretation. Use unit to communicate the measurement context; no range is imposed by this model.
NumberUnboundedElement.title: Plain unbounded numeric value primitive element.

value.description: Score represented by the filled portion of the star display.
value.title: Numeric rating score

maximum.description: Upper end of the rating scale. When omitted, the scale is five; value should use the same scale.
maximum.title: Maximum rating scale (defaults to 5)

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

NumberBoundedStarsElement.description: Displays a score on a star scale. Keep value within the scale from zero through maximum; this model declares the scale metadata but does not impose a numeric validation bound.
NumberBoundedStarsElement.title: Bounded numeric rating represented as visual stars.

value.description: Current measurement or score represented by the meter.
value.title: Numeric value

minimum.description: Lower end of the meter range. Defaults to zero when omitted.
minimum.title: Minimum scale bound (defaults to 0)

maximum.description: Upper end of the meter range. Choose a bound consistent with value and minimum.
maximum.title: Maximum scale bound (e.g. 100)

label.description: Optional readout text to use instead of a renderer-generated value and range label.
label.title: Optional custom text label override (e.g. "68 / 100")

unit.description: Unit associated with the value, such as a percent sign. This affects display only and does not convert the numeric value.
unit.title: Optional unit suffix (e.g. "%")

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

NumberBoundedMeterElement.description: Displays a scalar value against a minimum-to-maximum range. Supply comparable bounds and a value in that range; optional label and unit customize the textual readout without changing the meter scale.
NumberBoundedMeterElement.title: Bounded numeric meter representation (read-only progress / score bar).

value.description: State to display. This remains a boolean value in the data model even when the renderer substitutes custom labels.
value.title: Boolean state value

representation.description: Selects ordinary text or a badge pill. Badge color applies only to badge presentation.
representation.title: Display representation mode

trueLabel.description: Text used for the true state in plain representation. Defaults to the literal text true.
trueLabel.title: Custom display label when true (defaults to "true")

falseLabel.description: Text used for the false state in plain representation. Defaults to the literal text false.
falseLabel.title: Custom display label when false (defaults to "false")

variant.description: Semantic color treatment for badge presentation; it has no effect in plain representation.
variant.title: Badge color tone when rendered as badge

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

BooleanElement.description: Displays a boolean state using text or a badge. The representation determines whether true/false labels or a colored badge are used; configured labels and variant are presentation choices only.
BooleanElement.title: Boolean value primitive with text or badge presentation.

value.description: Unix epoch timestamp measured in milliseconds. Convert seconds-based timestamps before assigning this value.
value.title: The timestamp in milliseconds

format.description: Controls whether the timestamp is shown as date and time, date only, time only, or relative text. The default is datetime.
format.title: Presentation date/time format

modifiers.title: Optional visual modifiers (copyable, truncate, emphasis, monospace)

TimestampElement.description: Displays an epoch timestamp using a selected date/time format. The input is a count of milliseconds, not seconds; relative formatting is interpreted by the consumer.
TimestampElement.title: Formatted date and time representation.

src.description: Source URI understood by the client renderer. Supported forms include HTTPS locations, base64 data URIs, and client asset paths; this field is not raw image bytes.
src.title: Image source URI (HTTPS URL, base64 data URI, or asset path)

alt.description: Alternative text describing the image for assistive technology. Provide meaningful text when the image conveys information; omit it only when it is decorative.
alt.title: Accessible alternative description

aspectRatio.description: Preferred ratio of the rendered thumbnail container, expressed as a ratio string such as 1:1. It controls presentation rather than modifying the source image.
aspectRatio.title: Aspect ratio of the thumbnail container

placeholder.description: Optional source to display when the primary image cannot be loaded. It follows the same URI conventions as src.
placeholder.title: Fallback placeholder image URI

ImageReferenceElement.description: References an image source for thumbnail rendering and provides accessible text and a fallback source. The client determines loading, sizing, and placeholder behavior.
ImageReferenceElement.title: Thumbnail image reference with placeholder fallback handling.

content.description: Markdown source consumed by the client renderer. The schema treats it as an opaque string and does not validate the markup or its links.
content.title: Raw Markdown markup content

MarkdownBlockElement.description: Use this custom-renderer escape hatch when the structured ViewKit elements cannot express the required rich text. Markdown rendering is a presentation fallback; prefer typed elements when consumers need to inspect individual values.
MarkdownBlockElement.title: Full Markdown fallback block rendered with core typographic hierarchy, spacing, and styling.

content.description: HTML source passed to the custom renderer. This is an opaque string, not a typed or sanitized DOM structure.
content.title: Raw HTML markup content

HtmlBlockElement.description: Use only when structured elements or Markdown cannot represent the required content. Rendering occurs in a sandboxed host context, but callers should still avoid embedding untrusted content and should not assume access to application privileges.
HtmlBlockElement.title: Sandboxed HTML rendering escape hatch.

slots.description: Ordered slots in the row. Each slot's width is a percentage; arrange slot definitions in the intended visual order.
slots.title: List of slots comprising the row

MultiSlotElement.description: Use this layout when a row needs explicit regions with independently controlled widths. Each slot contains one child element; unlike FlowingElement, the layout does not automatically wrap a sequence of children.
MultiSlotElement.title: Horizontal row layout with individually sized slots.

separator.description: Separator placed between adjacent elements. Omit it when spacing or the child renderers already provide sufficient separation.
separator.title: Optional visual separator rendered between sequential child elements

elements.description: Ordered children rendered in the flow. The client wraps them as needed rather than requiring callers to calculate line breaks.
elements.title: List of child elements rendered sequentially with line wrapping

FlowingElement.description: Use for compact related values that should flow horizontally and wrap naturally at the available width. Child order is preserved; an optional separator is placed between neighboring children.
FlowingElement.title: Inline layout container that wraps child elements.

label.description: Human-readable name for the value. This text is rendered as the row label rather than as a separate UiElement.
label.title: Key or descriptive label displayed muted on the left

value.description: Value content rendered in the right-hand region. It may be a primitive or a nested structural element.
value.title: Rendered value element on the right

withDivider.description: Enables a horizontal separator beneath this row when true. Defaults to false.
withDivider.title: Whether to render a bottom border/hairline divider

LabelValueElement.description: Represents one named value with a muted left-hand label and a right-hand visual element. Use it for a single field; use TableElement for repeated rows or column-aligned data.
LabelValueElement.title: Label and value row with an optional divider.

isStriped.description: Enables alternating backgrounds across successive rows to improve scanability. Defaults to false.
isStriped.title: Whether to render alternating row background colors

withColumnSeparators.description: Adds vertical dividers between columns when true. Defaults to false.
withColumnSeparators.title: Whether to render vertical column separators

withRowSeparators.description: Adds horizontal dividers between rows when true. Defaults to false.
withRowSeparators.title: Whether to render horizontal row separators

columns.description: Optional ordered column metadata defining headers, alignment, and width. When omitted, the renderer may infer a basic layout from row cells.
columns.title: Optional explicit column definitions

rows.description: Ordered table rows. Each row's cells correspond positionally to the declared columns.
rows.title: Tabular data rows

TableElement.description: Use for data that benefits from aligned rows and columns, including key/value and multi-column tables. Supply rows in display order; explicit columns are optional, and divider/striping flags independently control visual separators and alternating backgrounds.
TableElement.title: Structured tabular data with optional columns and separators.

title.description: Heading displayed for the repeated section, separate from the labels of individual entries.
title.title: Optional section header for the group

entries.description: Entries in display order. Each entry supplies its own label and content.
entries.title: List of repeated entry records

RepeatingGroupElement.description: Groups a sequence of labeled entries under one optional section title. Use it when records have the same general presentation but need their own labels.
RepeatingGroupElement.title: Repeating group container where entries share uniform structure and retain per-entry labels.

title.description: Text shown on the disclosure control. Use a concise action or section name that remains meaningful while the content is collapsed.
title.title: Group title (e.g. "Show specimen details")

summary.description: Compact contextual text shown alongside the title while the group is collapsed or expanded. It does not replace the nested content.
summary.title: Secondary summary indicator (e.g. "2 neutral values")

defaultExpanded.description: Initial expanded state requested by the data. Defaults to false; subsequent interaction is managed by the client.
defaultExpanded.title: Whether the disclosure is open/expanded by default

elements.description: Ordered child elements made visible by expanding the group.
elements.title: Nested content elements revealed when expanded

CollapsibleGroupElement.description: Groups nested content behind a disclosure control. The title names the group, summary can provide a compact status indicator, and defaultExpanded controls only the initial state.
CollapsibleGroupElement.title: Collapsible disclosure container (accordion) with summary badge.

style.description: Visual stroke treatment for the separator. Defaults to a subtle hairline.
style.title: Line styling

DividerElement.description: A standalone visual separator for dividing adjacent sections or element groups. Use the divider flags on tables or rows when the separator is part of that structure.
DividerElement.title: Visual hairline separator separating sections or element groups.

StringRepresentation.title: Visual presentation style for string values.

truncate.description: Optional text abbreviation behavior. The source text remains unchanged, and the renderer may offer expansion according to showMore.
truncate.title: Configures character truncation threshold with show-more affordance

weight.description: Relative font weight for textual rendering; defaults to normal.
weight.title: Typographic text weight

intensity.description: Relative contrast treatment for the text; defaults to medium.
intensity.title: Visual text color intensity

monospace.description: When true, requests a fixed-width font suitable for identifiers and code-like values. Defaults to false.
monospace.title: Whether to use monospace font rendering (for hashes, IDs, codes)

PrimitiveModifiers.description: Extends BaseModifiers with text styling controls. Defaults provide normal weight, medium intensity, and proportional text unless a feature explicitly overrides them.
PrimitiveModifiers.title: Common modifier traits that can be attached to primitive elements.

Separator.title: Visual separator rendered between sequential elements or items.

CodeLanguage.title: Supported syntax highlighting languages for formatted code blocks.

copyable.description: When true, exposes a copy affordance for the associated value where supported by the renderer.
copyable.title: Adds an interactive copy button/action next to the rendered value

BaseModifiers.description: Common optional presentation traits shared by primitive values and content renderers. Modifiers affect how content is displayed or copied; they do not transform the source value.
BaseModifiers.title: Base modifier traits for elements that support copy affordance.

Shape.title: Geometric shape representation for visual containers and indicators.

Size.title: Relative sizing scale for visual elements and indicators.

BooleanRepresentation.title: Visual presentation style for boolean values.

BadgeVariant.title: Visual color tone variants for badge pill representations.

TimestampFormat.title: Presentation format styles for timestamp elements.

label.description: Short text identifying this region of the row. It is independent of the rendered content.
label.title: Optional slot label (e.g. "Slot A")

width.description: Relative share of the row width. The schema constrains explicit values to the inclusive range 1 through 100.
width.title: Width percentage (1-100)

content.description: One visual element displayed in this slot. Use a nested layout element when the slot itself needs multiple children.
content.title: Rendered content inside the slot

Slot.description: A slot combines an optional label, a relative width, and one visual child. Slot widths are percentages of the row and should be chosen so the full row's widths form a usable layout.
Slot.title: Single slot within a multi-slot horizontal row layout.

header.description: Optional header shown above values in this column. Omit when the table has no header row.
header.title: Display header text

align.description: Horizontal alignment applied to cell content in the column. Defaults to left.
align.title: Text horizontal alignment

width.description: Column width percentage used with widthMode. Explicit values are constrained to 1 through 100.
width.title: Width percentage (1-100)

widthMode.description: Determines whether width is a fixed percentage allocation or an upper bound. Defaults to fixed.
widthMode.title: Sizing mode for the provided width

TableColumn.description: Describes one table column and its visual sizing. When columns are supplied, their order corresponds to the position of each cell in a row.
TableColumn.title: Column definition for structured tables.

cells.description: Ordered contents for this row. Each cell is a UiElement so values can use the same primitive and layout renderers as other ViewKit content.
cells.title: Array of cell values corresponding to table columns

TableRow.description: A row's cell array is positional: cell at each index corresponds to the column at that index. Keep row lengths aligned with the table's explicit column definitions when present.
TableRow.title: Single table row containing an array of cell values.

label.description: Short label identifying this entry within the repeated group.
label.title: Entry label

value.description: Optional primary visual value for a compact entry. Use elements for a multi-part structured entry.
value.title: Primary entry value or nested elements

elements.description: Optional ordered content for entries that require more than one value element.
elements.title: Nested elements for structured entries

RepeatingGroupEntry.description: A repeating entry carries a stable display label and either one primary value or a list of nested elements, depending on the shape needed by the feature.
RepeatingGroupEntry.title: Single entry within a repeating group.

DividerStyle.description: Selects the visual stroke treatment used by DividerElement.
DividerStyle.title: Visual styling variants for hairline dividers.

characterLimit.description: Threshold after which the renderer can shorten the displayed text. This does not constrain the stored string or remove its undisplayed content.
characterLimit.title: Maximum number of characters to display before truncating

showMore.description: When true, permits an expand/collapse control for text beyond the truncation threshold. Defaults to true.
showMore.title: Whether to render a "Show more" / "Show less" toggle affordance

TruncateOptions.description: Controls how a renderer abbreviates long text. The character limit is a presentation threshold rather than a validation limit; showMore lets the user reveal the remaining text.
TruncateOptions.title: Truncation configuration for long textual content with optional expand affordance.

TextIntensity.title: Visual text color intensity and contrast.

TableColumnAlign.description: Horizontal alignment applied within cells of a TableColumn. The alignment is a presentation choice and does not affect the stored cell values.
TableColumnAlign.title: Text horizontal alignment options for table columns.

TableColumnWidthMode.description: Controls how an optional TableColumn width is interpreted by the table renderer.
TableColumnWidthMode.title: Width mode for table columns.

type.description: Concrete action tag used by clients to select the action behavior.
type.title: Discriminator property

label.description: User-facing label shown on the control. Keep it short and action-oriented.
label.title: Display label for the action

label.description: User-facing label shown on the control. Keep it short and action-oriented.
label.title: Display label for the action

UiAction.description: Shared action contract for user-invokable card controls. Concrete action models provide their own discriminator and action-specific destination or command fields.
UiAction.title: Polymorphic base model for interactive actions.

label.description: User-facing label shown on the control. Keep it short and action-oriented.
label.title: Display label for the action

extensionId.description: Extension that registers commandId. Omit only when the client can resolve the command in the current extension context.
extensionId.title: Extension identifier owning the target command

commandId.description: Identifier of the registered extension command to dispatch when the button is activated.
commandId.title: Command identifier to invoke

target.description: Optional entity or context identifier forwarded to the command handler. Its format is determined by the target extension.
target.title: Target entity or context identifier

parameters.description: JSON-compatible arguments passed to the extension command. Define and validate their shape in the command implementation.
parameters.title: Optional arbitrary parameters payload forwarded to the command handler

disabled.description: When true, the client renders the action as unavailable and should not dispatch it from user activation.
disabled.title: Whether the button is disabled / unavailable

variant.description: Selects the button's emphasis style. Use danger for destructive operations and primary for the main recommended action; the variant does not change behavior.
variant.title: Button visual style variant

ButtonActionElement.description: When activated, the client dispatches commandId to the specified extension and may include target and parameters as command input. disabled and variant affect presentation and availability, not the command's authorization.
ButtonActionElement.title: Interactive button action triggering an extension command.

label.description: User-facing label shown on the control. Keep it short and action-oriented.
label.title: Display label for the action

url.description: External destination opened when the user activates the link action. The client controls how external navigation is handed to the platform.
url.title: Target URL destination

ExternalLinkActionElement.description: Renders a user-invokable action that opens a destination externally. Use StringUrlElement for a link embedded in content rather than an action control.
ExternalLinkActionElement.title: External link action distinct from inline URL text values.

ButtonVariant.title: Visual style variants for interactive button actions.
